hook: The Amalfi Coast in six scenes
caption:
Six little scenes from the Amalfi Coast that make you want to book a window seat. 🍋🇮🇹

📍 Positano — pastel houses tumbling down the hillside.
📍 Ravello — gardens with views stretching to the sea.
📍 Amalfi — sunny afternoons among the beach umbrellas.
📍 Ravello — old stone lanes made for wandering.
📍 Path of the Gods — incredible views across the coast.
📍 Amalfi waterfront — slow down by the boats.

Save this for your next Italian escape.

Photos: Ian Mackey, nella n., Margo Evardson, Emran Yousof, Sekwang Chia & Chloé Lefleur / Unsplash.

#YourTravelAtlas #AmalfiCoast #ItalyTravel #TravelInspiration
editorial_intent: Show Italy's Amalfi Coast as a beautiful varied holiday experience through six exact location-specific photo moments rather than just one postcard view.
share_reason: The six named Italian coast experiences form a memorable visual wishlist spanning a town, gardens, sea, street, hike view and waterfront.
